ios.desc:
Breathe Better. Feel Better. Live Better.

The Breathing App helps you calm your mind, reduce stress, and restore balance through simple guided breathing.
Inspired by Resonance Frequency, a science-backed breathing technique proven to improve sleep, focus, and emotional balance in just a few minutes a day.

What Is Resonance Breathing?

Resonance Frequency is a natural rhythm where your heart rate, blood pressure, and brainwaves synchronize into a coherent wave.
Breathing at 5–7 breaths per minute brings your body into this state of calm, restorative balance, activating both sides of your nervous system:
	•	The sympathetic branch (energy and action)
	•	The parasympathetic branch (rest and recovery)

The result: calm alertness, better sleep, and improved emotional resilience.

What’s Inside
	•	Free forever: Kids & Resonance Frequency ratios, up to 20-minute sessions
	•	Beautiful minimalist design & calming sounds by Moby and Maejor
	•	Works with screen off & in background
	•	Simple access to a calm, non-thinking state
	•	No ads, no account required

Premium unlocks:
	•	Advanced Calming, Focusing, Energizing & Grounding breathing ratios
	•	Unlimited timers
	•	Alternate-nostril & guided sound breathing
	•	A full sonic experience for deeper practice

For Everyone

Whether you’re dealing with stress, anxiety, or insomnia, or simply want to improve your focus and energy — The Breathing App is your daily reset button.

Created with Love
Eddie Stern, Sergey Varichev, Maks Luhouski & Dilesh Mehta
Music: Moby & Maejor

Subscription Info

Start your 7-day free trial to access all premium features:
	•	$4.99/month or $44.99/year (US pricing; varies by country) *
	•	Manage or cancel anytime in your iTunes settings.
	•	Core features remain free forever.

* Prices in other countries may vary, and charges may be converted to your local currency based on your country of residence. Your premium subscription automatically renews unless you disable auto-renew in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before your current period ends. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew at any time in your iTunes Account Settings. Your iTunes Account will be charged once your purchase is confirmed. When canceling a subscription or a free trial, your subscription/free trial will stay active until the end of the current period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.

Read the Terms & Conditions here:
https://www.thebreathing.a

android.desc:
The Breathing App (TBA) original is inspired by Resonance Frequency—the scientific term that describes what happens when our heart rate, heart rate variability, blood pressure, and brainwave function align in a coherent wave. This occurs spontaneously when we breathe at a pace of five to seven breaths per minute, resulting in calm, restful alertness and other benefits.

About Resonance Frequency

The effects of resonance support the innate ability of our body, nervous system, and emotions to restore themselves. This is achieved by balancing the two complementary branches of the autonomic nervous system, which governs heart rate, blood pressure, digestion, respiration, and other automatic functions.

How is it possible for one breathing technique to do so much? The answer lies within our nervous system. By breathing at your resonance frequency, you enter into an even balance between the two branches of the autonomic nervous system:

The sympathetic branch, which moves us toward activity
The parasympathetic branch, which moves us toward rest

New Updates
Although TBA focuses on Resonance Frequency, we’ve added advanced ratios to expand your breath practice repertoire. These ratios also use our breathing sounds to guide you.

What’s in the App?

TBA includes:
2 Kids Ratios (Free)
4 Resonance Frequency Ratios (Free)
4 Focusing Breathing Ratios (Premium)
4 Energizing Breathing Ratios (Premium)
4 Calming Breathing Ratios (Premium)
4 Grounding Breathing Ratios (Premium)

Each breath group offers beginner through advanced practices to suit your breathing needs.

All breath practices can be done through both nostrils for normal breathing, or through one nostril at a time for alternate-nostril breathing, giving you flexibility in your practice.

Our breath sound feature, along with the expanded section on ratios, is a great teaching tool. Many of the included ratios were created with yoga and breath teachers in mind for use in classes.

Free Features
This is a free app, and the basic features will remain available forever, including:
Kids Ratios and Resonance Ratios
Timers up to 20 minutes
Elegant, simple design
Guiding sounds
No account required
No ads

Premium Subscription

quotes.text:
Here's a free, ad-free phone app that does a slightly more engaging version of the same thing: https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/the-breathing-app/id1285982210 , https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.ayny.breathingapp&hl=en_US&gl=US

The technique it implements is called resonance breathing AKA resonance frequency breathing: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC8924557/

If you've wanted to try meditation but haven't made time, try 3 minutes in that app and work up to 5-10. 5 minutes is enough to measure a difference in HRV.
quotes.story_title: Show HN: Improve cognitive focus in 1 minute

quotes.text:
Nice to see more awareness of breathing exercises. I’ve been using “The Breathing App”: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/the-breathing-app/id1285982210 (iOS, free, no gimmicks).

3 minutes of 5:7 is enough to see a measurable change in HRV. 5 minutes is downright relaxing.
